svg.text: One frame per mode, canopy, Nsight Systems capture N2 (Perfect Presentation on), drawn from the report's data
Left: one frame, from its 'copy inputs' group (no SwapBuffers with Perfect Presentation) until the GPU has done its work (the GPU runs behind the CPU). Right: zoomed in on the Bridge's GPU work.
CPU = the render thread; GPU = OpenGL work on the GPU. DirectX work isn't traced: it shows as the hatched gap in the OpenGL queue.
